user.title: Connect FordPass China
user.description: Before continuing, review Ford's [Privacy Policy](https://www.ford.com.cn/privacy-policy/) and [FordPass Terms](https://www.fordpass.com.cn/content/ford_com/fp_app/zh_cn/terms-fordpass.html). Confirming sends the required consent flags to Ford's sign-in page; no additional consent is opted into.

data.accept_terms: I have read and accept Ford's privacy policy and service terms

authorize.title: Sign in to FordPass China
authorize.description: Open the [Ford sign-in page]({login_url}) in a browser. After signing in, copy the complete final redirect URL and paste it below. Your Ford password stays on Ford's site.

error.terms_required: You must accept Ford's terms before opening the sign-in page
error.private_config_missing: Private protocol configuration is missing or not private
error.invalid_auth: Ford authorization failed or no vehicle was returned
error.token_exchange_failed: Ford rejected the authorization-code exchange. Sign in again for a fresh code.
error.protocol_error: Ford could not decrypt the integration's request (100500). Pause sign-in attempts while the protocol is corrected.

abort.reauth_entry_missing: The integration entry could not be found
